description_text:
A 7-segment display, complete with individual LED polygons, housing packaging and electrical pins accurately recreates real-life seven segment display packages. This product includes base textures along with their PSD (Photoshop) image counterparts for ease of manipulation. It may be imported into popular modelling tools such as 3DS, Maya or Blender or may be used directly in popular gaming engines that support the FBX file format.
The package may be edited in programs such as 3D Studio Max and exported as an FBX file to other programs or gaming engines as required by the user. The parts are well named to allow programmatic interaction from third party components that may switch on and off emissive LEDs or driven by other programmatic means. It is not necessary however to use any programming to use this product.

  - LEDs modelled as named polygons for both the on and off state.

  - Package elements including display segments may be removed or edited in any compatible 3D authoring program.

  - Optimised package for use in games whilst maintaining a balance of visual fidelity.

  - Includes UVW Unwrapped and regular textures for pins, LED on and off segments, case and display face for use in gaming engines.

  - LEDs have their own textures assigned for lit and unlit effects.

  - Effectively named parts allows ease of reference, part removal or reworking as needed.

  - PSD Files are included with appropriately named layers and text information for layer names.

  - Plain coloured emissive and non-emissive LED segments.

  - May be customised with UV textures if required.

  - All LED parts are named and grouped into a simple hierarchy.

  - Built accurately to scale. LEDs are geometrically modelled after the most common segment shapes seen since the 1980s.

  - Minimal vertex count maintaining a balance between performance and fidelity once imported into popular 3D Engines (such as Unity 5 or Unreal Engine 4).

  - Model provided as an Autodesk Inc. 3D Studio Max 2017 (.max) file, a Film-box Exchange file (.fbx) and a Blender (.blender) v2.8 file format.

  - Textures are relative to the .max and .fbx files to eliminate resource location when importing into gaming and 3D authoring engines.

description_text:
•         Let me present to you high-quality middle-poly 3D model of vacuum cleaner Dyson DC37. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real vacuum cleaner that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•        The model uses 18 simple colored materials and 6 materials with 4 textures used in various combination and 2 of them is used as mask for sign, logos etc.• The model is Rigged and has Character set with 6 poses. This Rig Setup mainly expects to set any static pose for interior or object visualization, but simple animation you can create too. If you need to create difficult animation with dynamic on hose you can create your own Rig with any NOT_RIGGED_POSES scenes which include no deformed hose mesh, or set Default_hose_Pose in Character Poses.
• To control model with Rig Setup select only control curves. These curves include all necessary channels to control the Character model. Blend Parent attribute needs to detach some model parts for individual positioning like head, container, filter, pipe. Geometry, Control Curves, and Clusters are in relevant Display Layers. If you need to hide the relevant part group of the model (head, pipe, etc.) use the Visibility attribute on Control Curves.
• NOT_RIGGED_POSES scenes not have Rig Setup and include simple models in basic poses for use in other 3D programs. All scenes format except .mb and .ma have no Rigging Setup.
•        The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
•        The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
•        Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. description_text:
SEGA Megadrive 2 LARGE SCENE. A large heavily detailed all quad-SubD production ready, fully UV unwrapped, textured and shaded scene made out of 6 different separate sub-scenes/complex models (that are sold separately also).

  - SEGA Megadrive 2 Console 

  - Two 3-Button Gamepads (With different cables configuration)

  - SEGA Arcade Power Stick/Joystick

  - SEGA Cartridge And Plastic Box Cases (Opened and Closed/Both Versions)

  - SEGA 32X Console Add-on

  - Carpet/Rug Platform

The model is all pure quad-SubD (Subdivision Surfaces) polygonal model ONLY (no n-gons or triangles, perfect topology), modelled in a non-destructive fashion (no collapsed/frozen modifiers), extremely detailed with all the features modeled via geometry in extreme precision, with only small power, reset and cartridge input ingravings only displaced via displacement map, everything else is modelled in pure geo. Production ready model, completely UV Unwrapped, with 45 UDIM UV maps. Backside elements, screws, stickers are also present. 
Feautures and Important Info:
  - SEGA Megadrive 2 LARGE SCENE is modelled and rendered in FOUNDRY MODO, hence it comes with MODO shaders and materials; to get the same rendring results use MODO 801 or higher versions.  For 3DSMAX users, just interchange MODO native materials/shaders for your desired like VRAY or for CORONA engine, all the textures and UV mappings are transfered with modifiers applied on top (like Edit Poly and Turbosmooth). You will probably have to tweak some textures manualy to fit your desired rendering engine. 
-60 Textures (ranging from multiple 4K, 2K, 1K and many smaller that are tileable or not)

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model DJI Phantom 2 Quadcopter with Propeller Guard, Zenmuse H4-3D gimbal for GoPro Hero4 or 3 and GoPro HERO4 action camera. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real quadcopter, camera and gimbal that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has four materials. One material for glass lens on camera, one for quadcopter, one for gimbal and one for camera.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 14. Resolution of all textures is from 2048 to 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• You can animate propeller with the simple rotation of propeller mesh. Also you can animate gimbal position with the simple rotation needed level group. They are three level group hierarchy for each hinge. Also you can use quadcopter without propeller guard, just hide the propeller guard mesh. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max (2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers. USB/HDMI ports cover is hide inside camera model.

description_text:
- Robotic toy arm rigged with remote control.

  - Rig with instructions and animation with remote control included.

  - Designed for close-up.

  - Easy to use.

  - Units of file: centimeters.

  - Size in centimeters robotic toy arm: 27.4 (X axis), 50.5 (Y axis), 54.5 (Z axis).

  - Size in centimeters remote control: 15.8 (X axis), 9.6 (Y axis), 4.1 (Z axis).

  - Real world scale. (1,1,1).

  - Focused on the origin.

TOPOLOGY

  - Two object with 43 manifold meshes (8 remote control and 35 robotic toy arm).

  - 100% quads. (25,251 total: 3,844 remote control and 21,407 robotic toy arm).

  - 25,249 vertices total: 3,838 remote control and 21,411 robotic toy arm).

  - 50,502 edges total: 7,688 remote control and 42,814 robotic toy arm).

  - Subdividable topology.

  - Clean edge flow.

  - No isolated vertices.

  - No coincident vertices.

  - No coincident/coplanar faces.

  - No faces intersected. 

  - No faces distorted more than 45 degrees.

  - No loss geometry.

  - No poles with more than 5 edges.

RIG

  - Two armature, with 53 bones in total, 27 animables and other auxiliary.

  - Rig instructions and animation with remote control included.

  - Includes system FK and IK, interchangeable through a property of armature.

  - Includes a bone for holding objects.

  - The bones are replaced by shapes, with forms and color guidance.

  - The actions and its range of allowable values are controlled by constraint on each bone.

  - The objects and auxiliary bones are hidden and another layer.

  - Easy to use.

UVMAP AND TEXTURES 

  - Normal outward.

  - UV without overlapping.

  - Twenty-two materials, one for each color, and optional procedural texture, so you do not need to use textures.

  - All textures of 8192x8192 pixels.

Image textures included:

  - control_robotic_toy_arm_diffuse.png

  - control_robotic_toy_arm_bump.png

  - control_robotic_toy_arm_normal.png (OPTIONAL, also included in .zip)

  - robotic_toy_arm_diffuse.png

  - robotic_toy_arm_normal.png (OPTIONAL, also included in .zip)

PREVIEWS

  - The images of the mesh and bones are in orthographic view.

  - Renders with the Blender internal engine. All without post production.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model DJI Phantom 2 Quadcopter with Zenmuse H4-3D gimbal for GoPro Hero3-4 and GoPro HERO4 action camera. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real quadcopter, camera and gimbal that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has four materials. One material for glass lens on camera, one for quadcopter, one for gimbal and one for camera.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 14. Resolution of all textures is from 2048 to 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• You can animate propeller with the simple rotation of propeller mesh. Also you can animate gimbal position with the simple rotation needed level group. They are three level group hierarchy for each hinge. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max (2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers. 
See also our model: DJI Phantom 2 Quadcopter with Prop Guard and GoPro HERO4.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model DJI Phantom 2 Quadcopter with Propeller Guard and Zenmuse H4-3D gimbal for GoPro Hero4 or 3. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real quadcopter and gimbal that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has two materials. One material for quadcopter and one for gimbal.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 9. Resolution of all textures is from 2048 to 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• You can animate propeller with the simple rotation of propeller mesh. Also you can animate gimbal position with the simple rotation needed level group. They are three level group hierarchy for each hinge. Also you can use quadcopter without propeller guard, just hide the propeller guard mesh. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max (2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.
See also our models: 

  - DJI Phantom 2 Quadcopter with Prop Guard and GoPro HERO3;

  - DJI Phantom 2 Quadcopter with GoPro HERO3, without propeller guard;

  - DJI Phantom 2 Quadcopter with Prop Guard and GoPro HERO4;

  - DJI Phantom 2 Quadcopter with GoPro HERO4, without propeller guard;

The Nikon FE is an advanced semi-professional level, interchangeable lens, 35 mm film, single-lens reflex SLR camera. It was manufactured by Nikon in Japan from 1978 to 1983, and was available new from dealer stock until circa 1984. The FE uses a metal-bladed, vertical travel focal plane shutter with a speed range of 8 to 1/1000 second, plus Bulb, and flash X-sync of 1/125th second. It had dimensions of 89.5 millimetres 3.52 in height, 142 mm 5.6 in width, 57.5 mm 2.26 in depth and 590 grams 21 oz weight. It was available in two colors: black with chrome trim and all black. As on the FM, its model designation did not appear on the front of the camera, but was engraved as a small 'FE' preceding the serial number on the rear of the housing.

description_text:
Neurons-fly-through visualization package:
This package contains an animated 3ds max project and accompanying After effects project files. The 3ds max file contains a large neural network environment and includes animated omni-lights to simulate neural synapses (see Vimeovideo on top). It also includes an environment map and library of shaders to make different kinds of render outputs possible.
The project file is setup with all necessary render elements, output formats and directory inputs. The render elements are combined in an After Effects project file (included and setup).
Note: For sake of data amount the render elements are not included in this package but the fist frames of every pass are, so one can use the After Effects file to see the result and fiddle around with variables. In this way one can determine which passes he wants to use to get his desired result and needs only those passes rendered out.
This combination provides a complete setup to create different kinds of animations and looks. (camera in 3ds max file is animated over a nurbs curve which can be altered easily) It is no problem to add secondary animation ore objects (for instance like nanobots,virus, etc.) You can simulate electron microscopy effects, Jelly like shading, or something out of this world.(see example renders on top) The After Effects files provides additional options to alter the look of the project. For instance, one can change lighting and shading conditions in near real-time, including refraction and reflections. This is done through a plug-in which is able to make use of Zbuffer and normal information to perform shading functions inside After Effects. The plugin is called Normality and is developed by Stefan Minning. You can download the After Effects plugin for free on his website.(http://www.3dcg.net/software/normality/
All techniques and explanation on how to work with this project are described in a detailed PDF guide included in this package.
Also delivered with this package is an 11 seconds Full HD output Quicktime movie,low compression for maximum quality (see Vimeo sample). The animation begins in the middle of traveling through a neural network and stops by entering a neuron. It can be used as an in-between for interior visualization of a neuron.
Ps. you need to have Frischluft Lenscare, Video copilot Optical flares, Normality and Magic bullet Looks (After Effects plugins) to make the After Effects files work. Al web links to plugins are included in the PDF guide.
Feel free to ask additional questions should you have any, (click the small envelope icon next to the Author name or enter his profile and use the green contact button on the left).
Have fun,

• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model DJI Phantom 2 Quadcopter with Zenmuse H4-3D gimbal for GoPro Hero4 or 3. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real quadcopter and gimbal that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has four materials. One material for quadcopter and one for gimbal.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 9. Resolution of all textures is from 2048 to 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• You can animate propeller with the simple rotation of propeller mesh. Also you can animate gimbal position with the simple rotation needed level group. They are three level group hierarchy for each hinge. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max (2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

The Grumman E-2C Hawkeye is a twin-engine turboprop carrier based AWACs radar surveillance and control aircraft.  Its mission is to maintain a surveillance of the sky and sea at long range to protect the fleet from attack as well as to act as a command and control aircraft in a complicated and difficult multi-disciplined attack mission.

This model is fully textured and includes all materials and textures as shown here.

description_text:
This is a 3D simulation that illustrates an axial plane view into
 one of the layers of the Cerebral cortex, containing pyramidal neurons.  
The scene is build up of a large set of instanced 3D subdivided models (center region)
in combination with cylindrical billboard opacity mapped neurons (outside region).
There's al large degree of freedom of movement within this scene.
Make al sort of flythrough situations ore zoom close-up shots.
Currently there's an animated camera on a circular path.  
The package contains following items:  

  - A 3ds max file setup with Vray renderer containing a vast neural network environment
consisting of 187 variations of instanced 3D models of 5 different neuron models.
also includes shaders (electron microscopy effect), billboards, animated camera and
texture environment.

  - A 3ds max file setup with native scanline renderer consisting of same scene but
normals inverted for interior rendering of the neurons.

  - A 3ds max file setup with native scanline renderer containing the 5 unique neuron models.

  - An export OBJ file containing the 5 unique neuron models for import to all other major
3d applications. (geometry only)

  - An export OBJ file containing the neural network for import to all other major
3d applications. (geometry only)

  - An After Effects file that combines the render outputs and provides all settings to
alter the final look.

  - A map with some hi-res final renders

  - 3 textures and 6 billboard renders

  - A PDF with some instructions on how to use the project. 

Feel free to ask additional questions should you have any, (click the small envelope icon next to the Author name or enter his profile and use the green contact button on the left).
Have fun,

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Bork K810. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc.. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real kettle that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has a few materials for body (with photo-textures), brew pot and netting of spout, chromed surfaces, glass parts, symbols and logos (mask-material).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 9. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .jpg format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• Basic parts of the model are in relevant groups which allow you to move and animate teapot and stand, cover and brew pot.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

The Nikon FE is an advanced semi-professional level, interchangeable lens, 35 mm film, single-lens reflex SLR camera. It was manufactured by Nikon in Japan from 1978 to 1983, and was available new from dealer stock until circa 1984. The FE uses a metal-bladed, vertical travel focal plane shutter with a speed range of 8 to 1/1000 second, plus Bulb, and flash X-sync of 1/125th second. It had dimensions of 89.5 millimetres 3.52 in height, 142 mm 5.6 in width, 57.5 mm 2.26 in depth and 590 grams 21 oz weight. It was available in two colors: black with chrome trim and all black. description_text:
Detailed and textured model of Sony Alpha 7R digidal camera with Carl Zeiss lens.
- every object has material's name, you can easily change or apply materials

.max format:
Rar archive contains three scenes
1. 3ds max 2011 with vray materials, which you can see in preview images studio renders.
2. 3ds max 2011 with mental ray materials.
3. 3ds max 2011 with simple standard scanline materials
Just put into your scene and render!
In each scene model is provided with mesh smooth modifier on stack on objects that need it. Mesh smooth is set 1 or 2 for renders. Body, lens and display are in different layers. 
.
.obj format:
Textures may have to be added manualy.
Rar archive contains two versions of model with simple materials:
1. Exported without collapsing after mesh smooth. Low or med poly mesh which you can see in preview images, good if you need to edit model.
2. Exported after appllying mesh smooth. Just import, apply materials and render
.

Simple materials.
.
.fbx and .3ds format:
Textures may have to be added manualy.
Rar archive contains model exported after appllying mesh smooth. Just import, apply materials and render.
.
.

without meshsmooth max,obj,lwo,xsi,c4d: 50 000 polygons
collapsed fbx,3ds,obj: 800 000 faces/450 000 polygons

description_text:
This is a fully rigged and animated 3ds max file, Most parts consist of subdivision control cages (low poly models + meshsmooth modifiers). The model consist of separate segments linked to a multiple segment IK chain. Each segment has its own rotation point so no deformations occur on meshes. The IK chain in turn is driven by a spline controller that is controlled by 5 dummy's. The knifes and tips in front and back are also animated. 
Note:  This is a 3ds max native project/file setup with its native spline IK rigging tools, included exchange formats deliver only the model, they do not support/provide the 3ds max rigging setup.If you want to import Snakebot-RS1 into other 3D software packages please check out this option and read description carefully (https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/various/various-models/snakebot-rs1-import-pack).
Package contains following items:

  - one 3ds max file rigged, animated and setup to render with default scanline renderer(fast but less photo real, see preview on top)

  - one 3ds max file rigged, animated and setup to render with Octane renderer (plug-in) (produced most renders you see on top)

  - Map with textures + texture environment and HDRI map

Note: Both 3ds max files are click render ready and deliver the results you see on top, however depending on the version of Octane render plug-in the shaders may convert to basic shaders.(file was made with Octane render 1.3 and only supports the shaders in that version natively)The scanline version renders in all 3ds max versions starting from 2010.
Feel free to ask additional questions should you have any, (click the small envelope icon next to the Author name or enter his profile and use the green contact button on the left).
Have fun,

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Canon EOS 8000D. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real camera that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The Closing\Opening of display or flash is animated with the simple rotation of flash or display mesh and group of display. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
• Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Canon EOS 760D. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real camera that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The Closing\Opening of display or flash is animated with the simple rotation of flash or display mesh and group of display. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
• Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Sony PlayStation VR. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real VR headset that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Sony PlayStation 4 with stand and controller. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Model is presented in three colors: Black, Glacier White and Grey 20th Anniversary Edition. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real game console that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of three meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has two materials (for Console and Controller).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 10. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• In addition there are textures with other diffuse, specular, glossiness and bump maps. The total of additional textures is 11.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max (2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers. 
See also our model:
  -   Sony PlayStation 4 Controller New Colors;

The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. • Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Canon VIXIA HF G30 HD. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real camcorder that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has three materials (Body, Strap and Glass Lens).

description_text:
Tech Greebles set 1 provides a collection of 3D shapes that can be used for designing technological oriented visuals, ideal for motion graphics, sci-fi scenery or VJ clips. The pack contains around 90 3D shapes perfectly fit for creating complex greeble scenes. The shapes are deliberately kept as low poly as possible in order to allow scenes made of 1000 ends of copy’s and keep memory usage low. The shapes are also accompanied with a multi layer shader (3ds max and Octane) that divides 4 materials with 3 masks allowing various ways to alter different elements of the shader. The shapes are also provided in OBJ and FBX exchange formats and they are accompanied with a set of standard textures for regular PBR workflows. The scene also contains some flat planes including a greeble displacement shader (only compatible with Octane render v4) 
The package contains following items:

  - One 3ds max file version 2016 containing a scene arrangement of 3D shapes depicting abstract sci-fi greeble patterns, including multi layer shader + displacement shader (Octane render v4 only) 

  - Part of this package is product (Tech Shapes TS2), copy following link to your browser to find detail description of it (https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/various/various-models/tech-shapes-ts2) 

  - Part of this package is also product (Tech Circuits TC1), copy following link to your browser to find detail description of it (https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/various/various-models/tech-circuits-tc1) 

Feel free to ask additional questions should you have any, (click the Author name on the right to enter his profile and then use the green contact button on the left to get to him). 
Have fun,

If you import the lowest resolution of the .obj, .fbx or .lwo version into a 3D Software that supports SubDivision surfaces, you can also change the resolution/smoothness of the SubDivision/Meshsmooth surfaces very easy. The base version of the model which is not smoothed has a polycount of 251401 polygons.

description_text:
Very high definition Generic Tablet Computer model with 8.4 Inch display size. Generic means this Tablet Computer does not exist in reality. Details like connectors, cameras, flash, speaker and screws are modelled. The model is created to scale, meaning it has the correct size in your 3D software. 
The geometry has been modelled with SubDivision/Meshsmooth surfaces. This means using the 3dSMax or the Maya 2013 version you can change the resolution/smoothness of the model very easy. If you import the lowest resolution of the .obj, .fbx or .lwo version into a 3D Software that supports SubDivision surfaces, you can also change the resolution/smoothness of the model very easy. The base version of the model which is not smoothed has a polycount of 13068 polygons.
For other software packages that do not support SubDivision surfaces the model is available in 3 different resolutions ranging from 13068 to 213509 polygons.
Max 2010 Format:Meshsmooth is applied so you can set the resolution of the SubDivision/Meshsmooth surfaces as you like.
Maya 2008 Format:The model is available in 3 different resolutions.
Maya 2013 Format:A selection set for all SubDivision surface parts is included so you can change the resolution of these parts easily.
FBX Format:The model is available in 3 different resolutions.
Cinema 4D 9.6 Format:The model is available in 3 different resolutions.
Lwo 6.0 Format:The model is available in 3 different resolutions. 
Obj Format:The model is available in 3 different resolutions. 
3ds Format:The model is available in 3 different resolutions.
Previews rendered in 3dsMax using VRay. Please note that the VRay materials and light settings are not included.

description_text:
Detailed and textured model of Nikon DF digidal camera with Nikkor lens.
- every object has material's name, you can easily change or apply materials

.max format:
Rar archive contains three scenes
1. 3ds max 2011 with vray materials, which you can see in preview images studio renders.
2. 3ds max 2011 with mental ray materials.
3. 3ds max 2011 with simple standard scanline materials
Just put into your scene and render!
In each scene model is provided with mesh smooth modifier on stack on objects that need it. Mesh smooth is set 1 or 2 for renders. Body and lens are in different layers. 
.
.obj format:
Textures may have to be added manualy.
Rar archive contains two versions of model with simple materials:
1. Exported without collapsing after mesh smooth. Low or med poly mesh which you can see in preview images, good if you need to edit model.
2. Exported after appllying mesh smooth. Just import, apply materials and render
.
.lwo, .xsi, .c4d format:
Textures may have to be added manualy.
Rar archive contains model exported without collapsing after mesh smooth. Low or med poly mesh which you can see in preview images, good if you need to edit model.
Simple materials.
.
.fbx and .3ds format:
Textures may have to be added manualy.
Rar archive contains model exported after appllying mesh smooth. Just import, apply materials and render.
.
.
Polycount:
without meshsmooth max,obj,lwo,xsi,c4d: 155 000 polygons
collapsed fbx,3ds,obj: 850 000 faces/550 000 polygons

description_text:
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray. Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

  - 3DS 2012

  - 1 file 360 product ( 60 images 1200*1200 pixels )All models before 8-2017 haven't 360 product but if you need it please contact us to get yours in 24 hours.-----------------------------Geometry:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth/Turbosmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

+ Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

- No texture paths referenced by the model. All texture paths were stripped from the model.About Bee3DD: ( Working in 3d modeling since 2013 until now )

  - We offer all electronics 3d model ( latest and oldest ). Our collection is biggest in the world. It is place where you can find anything about technology for your project ( earlier and faster than others )

  - Every model we build goes through thorough Quality assessment both visual and technical to make sure the assets look realistic and the models are of the best quality.

description_text:
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.
Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing. We take care to build the smallest detail in the model to ensure the best results. These things are not in others.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

+ 3DS 2012Features:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth/Turbosmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

  - Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+ 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

- No texture paths referenced by the model. All texture paths were stripped from the model.Thanks you for attention. Hope you can find proffesional model for your works.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Samsung Gear VR SM-R323N. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real VR headset that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of two meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has two materials (for lenses and googles bod).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness and Bump. If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 4. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model is presented in two basic poses - default pose and pose for use on human head 3D model.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• In addition we have rendered this model in other scene with HDRI lighting for more visual realism demonstration and a better understanding of materials characteristics. HDRI scene is not included for sale.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max (2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Canon EOS-1D C 4K. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real camera that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of one mesh, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
What we have here is a very accurate 3D CAD model of a 1960's [ 1962 mostly] Fender Stratocaster. This model has been put together with the intention of being a reliable source for manufacture by cnc and/or hand tools of a vintage USA Strat. It was made from measurements of my actual strat as well as others i came across while making and repairing electric guitars in the 1980's. Great care has been taken in getting it right. [i take my strats very seriously]. I have not made any texture packs or materials as i am only concerned with the geometry and the fit of the components. Over the years, i have made so many edits, changes, tweaks and improvements that i have actually lost track of all of them. Hence me changed the narrative here to be an accurate 3d model of an early 60's strat as that is the most accurate way to represent what we have here. 
If you would like any modifications or edits to the geometry, please feel free to contact me and i will be happy to assist you further. I also provide an A0 size PDF plan including all sizes, dimensions with a full list of components and where to purchase them. This has been a true labour of love and i provide it for you here so that you will not need to go to all the insane trouble i have gone to, to get a decent Vintage strat in these modern times! Worth noting here is that i have looked at the other strat's avaiable on the net and i just cant find one that even come close to this one. enjoy!
update 30/04/2021Thanks to Sitamiso for spotting a mistake in the neck/fingerboard profile geometry. I originally drew this neck in 2012 and since then have made numerous changes to the neck on client requests. I would never have looked this closely at the neck again so am very grateful for his eagly eye. I have corrected the neck models and uploaded the asm in 2 versions. step and parasolid. 
Good luck with building your strat...for me...its just the best guitar in the world ;) 
update 26/06/2021On client request, uploaded step and iges model called vintage stratocaster, this is the same model but including strings and tremolo arm.

description_text:
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.
Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing. We take care to build the smallest detail in the model to ensure the best results. These things are not in others.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

+ 3DS 2012Features:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth/Turbosmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

  - Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+ 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

- No texture paths referenced by the model. All texture paths were stripped from the model.Hire our team ( bee3dd ) for freelance works.Our team ( 14 people ) have over 5 experience. Available for freelance. Can do custom modeling, unwraping, texturing, rendering jobs. Our team are specialising in hard surface modelling and rendering mostly, but will consider any proposal.
On time and best quality, good price.Thanks you for attention. Hope you can find proffesional model for your works.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model GoPro HERO4 Silver Edition action camera with Waterproof Housing. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real action camera that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has a few materials for Waterhousing and Camera.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The model of Waterproof Housing uses 6 simple colored materials and 1 for glass. One material of black plastic uses Noise bump texture. For the best Bump depth for noise bump we set Bump Multiplier is 0.15 in Maya Software materials or V-Ray MTL materials for Maya.
• The total of the main textures is 6. Resolutions of all textures are from 512 to 2048 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• You can tilt head part of the model with the simple rotation “_top_part_group”.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Samsung WB2200F. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real camera that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of three meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only two materials (for Body and Glass of Lens).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The Closing\Opening of flash is animated with the simple rotation of flash mesh. All movable parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
• Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Dell Precision M6800 Workstation. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Model is presented in two colors: Black and Red. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real laptop that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of two meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has two materials (for Display and Body).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 10. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• In addition there are textures with other diffuse and specular colors. The total of additional textures is 4.
• The Closing\Opening of display is animated with the simple rotation of the display mesh. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
•  Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Acer Aspire Switch 10 tablet with keyboard. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc.. Model is presented in two colors: Silver and Black. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real tablet that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically
•    Ease of use consists of three meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 9. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The Closing\Opening of tablet is animated with the simple rotation of the tablet mesh. Also you can detach the tablet from the keyboard and use it separately. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• In addition we have rendered this model in other scene with HDRI lighting for more visual realism demonstration and a better understanding of materials characteristics. HDRI scene is not included for sale.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Samsung NX-300 Kit lens 18-55mm Brown. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real camera that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has three materials (for Body Camera, Lens and Glass of Lens).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 9. Resolution of all textures is 3000 pixels square aspect ratio in .jpg format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The Closing\Opening of display is animated with the simple rotation of display mesh and Display Group. All movable parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
• Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

total_file_size: SKP:3.43 MB
description_text:
3D model of the human powered vehicles for bicycle sharing systems and the BSS station itself. The vehicles shown are a bicycle and a kick scooter, both fitted with kinetic energy recovery systems. The vehicles were inspired on B2o and T2o of fritsch-durisotti. The KERS used was inspired on the 'Copenhagen Wheel', however instead of also having an electrical engine on the wheel to immediatelly consume the power generated from braking, the energy is simply stored (in a battery) and is provided to the bicycle station of the bicycle sharing systems when the bicycle is returned (after use by a client). Alternatively, the client can also choose to use the power he generated, ie to recharge any portable devices he carries (ie portable computer, cell phone, flashlight, ...)

The bicycle has been foreseen only with a front derailleur (and not a rear derailleur). This is mainly for durability and for maintenance reasons. The bicycle and kick scooter are also given full rubber tyres (not air-filled) again for reasons of durability. Most of the bicycle and kick scooter can also be made of wood of another low-cost material (ie plastic). If made of wood though, it should be hollowed out as much as possible to save weight. See the 'Purchasing_the_models' link at appropedia's AT_CAD_Team for additional information on the model

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Acer Aspire R7-572G. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc.. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real laptop that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically
•    Ease of use consists of three meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The Closing\Opening of display is animated with the simple rotation of display mesh and group. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
A collection of scientific correct 3d models of molecules! The relative distances from atom to atom, the relative size of the atoms to each other, the angles of the bonds and the amount of electron bond are scientifically correct(the van der Waals radius was used). Each download consists only of one model of the molecule.
The collection consists of following molecules:Adrenalin(C9H13NO3)Carbon Dioxide(CO2)Carbon Monoxide(CO)Dibromine(Br2)Dichlorine(Cl2)Dihydrogen(H2)Dinitrogen(N2)Ethanol(C2H6O)Hydrogen Peroxide(H2O2)Iodine(I2)Methane(CH4)Methanol(CH3OH)Nitric Oxide(NO)Nitrogen Dioxide(NO2)Ozone(O3)Water(H20)and more coming soon...
The amount of faces and vertices is high enough to give you a carefree experience that works for close ups as a presentation and shots that are a little bit further away.
All formats that do allow vertex color, groups and/or materials for exports have it enabled.
For the color assignment the CPK molecular model, designed by Robert Corey and Linus Pauling, was used.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Acer Aspire R 14 R3-471T. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc.. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real laptop that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically
•    Ease of use consists of three meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has two materials (Display and bottom part).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 10. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The Closing\Opening of display is animated with the simple rotation of display mesh and group. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Asus ZenWatch WI500Q. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc.. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real watch that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material. 
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model is presented in three basic poses with buckled up and unbuckled band.• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.
