description_text:
•         Let me present to you high-quality middle-poly 3D model Apple MacBook Pro 15.4 Retina. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real laptop that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•        The well topology of middle-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
•        The model uses 9 simple colored materials and 4 materials with 4 textures used in various combination and one of them is used as mask for sign, logos etc.
•        The total of the main textures is 4. Resolutions of all textures are from 1024 to 2352 pixels square aspect ratio in .jpg format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.• The Closing\Opening of display is animated with the simple rotation of the display group. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
•        The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
•        The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
•        Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
•        To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Middle-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

Lymphocytic choriomeningitis (LCM), is a rodent-borne viral infectious disease that presents as aseptic meningitis, encephalitis or meningoencephalitis. Its causative agent is the Lymphocytic Choriomeningitis Virus (LCMV), a member of the family Arenaviridae. The name was coined by Charles Armstrong in 1934.
In the Gale Encyclopedia of Medicine, second edition, lymphocytic choriomeningitis (LCM) is defined as “a viral infection of the membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord and of the cerebrospinal fluid.' The name is based on the tendency of an individual to have abnormally high levels of lymphocytes during infection. Choriomeningitis is “cerebral meningitis in which there is marked cellular infiltration of the meninges, often with a lymphocytic infiltration of the choroid plexuses.
LCMV is naturally spread by the common house mouse, Mus musculus. Once infected, these mice can become chronically infected by maintaining virus in their blood and/or persistently shedding virus in their urine. Chronically infected female mice usually transmit infection to their offspring (vertical transmission), which in turn become chronically infected. Other modes of mouse-to-mouse transmission include nasal secretions, milk from infected dams, bites, and during social grooming within mouse communities. Airborne transmission also occurs.
The virus seems to be relatively resistant to drying and therefore humans can become infected by inhaling infectious aerosolized particles of rodent urine, feces, or saliva, by ingesting food contaminated with virus, by contamination of mucus membranes with infected body fluids, or by directly exposing cuts or other open wounds to virus-infected blood. The only documented cases of transmission from animals have occurred between humans and mice or hamsters.
Cases of lymphocytic choriomeningitis have been reported in North and South America, Europe, Australia, and Japan, particularly during the 1900s. However, infection may occur wherever an infected rodent host population exists. Seroprevalence is approximately 5% (0.7-4.7%) of the US population. It tends to be more common among lower socio-economic groupings, probably reflecting more frequent and direct contacts with mice. However, obtaining an accurate sense of prevalence by geographic region is difficult due to underreporting.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Acer C7 Chromebook. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real netbook that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically
•    Ease of use consists of two meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The Closing\Opening of display is animated with the simple rotation of the display mesh. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Fujifilm FinePix X20 Black. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real camera that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only two materials (Body and Glass of Lens).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .jpg format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The Closing\Opening of flash is animated with the simple rotation of flash mesh. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
• Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Sony Cyber-shot DSC-RX1 Black. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real camera that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only two materials (for Body and Glass of Lens).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .jpg format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The Closing\Opening of flash is animated with the simple translation of flash mesh. All movable parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model MSI GE60 2PL Apache. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real laptop that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of two meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The Closing\Opening of display is animated with the simple rotation of the display mesh. All movable parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
HD model of HTC Windows Phone 8S. It contains all colors. The model is very accurate. I tuned up a scene for this result quite a long time so hope you will like it,

Available in the following file formats:

- 3ds Max with mental ray materials (.max)

- 3ds Max with V-Ray materials (.max)

- 3ds Max with Scanline materials (.max)

- 3D Studio (.3ds)

- FBX (.fbx)

- OBJ (.obj) optimized for:
- Blender
- Cinema 4D
- LightWave
- Maya
- Rhino
- Softimage XSI
- ZBrush
- 3D Model detailed polygonal model.

- Model centered at origin.

- The materials are available in the Max file format with V-Ray, mental ray and Standard (Scanline) materials. All other file formats are mesh only and will require material reapplication.

- High quality textures, perfect for extreme close-ups and high resolution renders.

- The preview images were rendered on 3ds Max 2011 with Vray 2.0.

- Native format is 3DS Max 9.

- You can easily change all the parts of the object, the stacks are not collapse.

- You can make the Poly count higher by the Meshsmooth level.
********************************
Production Ready
*********************************
- Note:. Studio setup is Not included.

- Includes V-Ray materials and textures only in 3ds Max format.

- NOTE: V-Ray is required for the V-Ray 3ds Max scene.

- A file without V-Ray shader is included with standard materials.

- The .3ds and .obj formats are geometry with texture mapping coords. No materials attached.

- Textures format JPEG.

- Model created in 3ds Max 9, Saved as Default Scanline,2009,2010,2011,2012,2013,2014,Maya 10,12, Lightwave 9.3,Rhino 4.0And C4D R12 as well.For thumbnails used V-Ray 2.0 renderer

- original file format 3DS Max 9

- big size textures included.

- One *.max file included Standart materials and Vray-materials.

- hi-poly model with meshsmooth modifier.

- In formats c4d, 3ds, Maya, obj, fbx, VRML,MenTal Ray - model exported to standard materials (textures), not contain Vray shaders.In these formats, shaders need to be edited for the new studio for the final rendering.

- All the materials are named.

- Geometry Only Polygonal.

- Model is mainly based on edge-loop mesh topology.

- This 3d model objects and materials have the correct names and striped the texture paths.

The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray. Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

  - 3DS 2012

  - 1 file 360 product ( 60 images 1200*1200 pixels )All models before 8-2017 haven't 360 product but if you need it please contact us to get yours in 24 hours.-----------------------------Geometry:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth/Turbosmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

+ Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

- No texture paths referenced by the model. All texture paths were stripped from the model.About Bee3DD: ( Working in 3d modeling since 2013 until now )

  - We offer all electronics 3d model ( latest and oldest ). Our collection is biggest in the world. It is place where you can find anything about technology for your project ( earlier and faster than others )

  - Every model we build goes through thorough Quality assessment both visual and technical to make sure the assets look realistic and the models are of the best quality.

Bee3dd is a team who making 3d model best quality, you don't need worry when use our models. We take care to build the smallest detail in the model to ensure the best results. These things are not in others.Our slogan is: best quality - best price!
  - We offer all electronics 3d model ( latest and oldest ). It is place where you can find anything about technology for your project ( earlier and faster than others )

Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

+ 3DS 2012Features:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth/Turbosmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

  - Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+ 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

Best regardBee3dd team

High Detailed Apple iPad 9.7 (2017) Gold 3d model with TurboSmooth modifier.
 The main format is 3ds Max 2010, also available in many formats.
Formats:
3ds Max 2010 and all higher versions.

  - Cinema 4D R11

  - 3ds

  - obj and

  - fbx

V-Ray and Standard material files are included into individual archive.
 Studio set-up (Light, Camera, Background) is not included.
 All textures included separately for all formats into each zipped folder.
 Other formats may vary slightly depending on your software.
Geometry and Poly Count : 3ds Max version (For Each)With TurboSmooth OFF = 16,840
 With TurboSmooth ON = 67,004 (Iterations=1)
Clean, polygonal, edge-loop, quads/tris based and smoothable (Subdivision ready) poly geometry.
The Cinema4D version (For Each):Polygons = 67,004

Render and Scene Management:Final images rendered with V-Ray 2.0.
 No Photoshop or compositing used.
 Model built to real-world scale (mm).
 Model is placed to 0,0,0 scene coordinates.
 Objects are in a layer and grouped for easy selection
 Texture and material names correspond to model name.
 All textures are path striped.
 The model is efficiently UV unwrapped.
 Non-overlapping UV's are applied where it is necessary.
Texture resolution:Maximum: 2,048 X 2,048
 Minimum: 1,549 X 2,057
Texture format: JPEG (.jpg)

High Detailed iPad Pro 10.5 2017 All Color with Pencil 3d model with TurboSmooth modifier.

3ds Max 2010 and all higher versions.

  - obj and

  - fbx

The main format is 3ds Max 2010.
 3ds Max 2010 V-Ray and Standard material scene are included into individual archive.
 All textures, Materials and HDRI map are included.
.c4d and .fbx formats contains medium high-poly.
 .3ds and obj format comes from low poly.
 Except HDRI all textures included separately for all formats into each zipped folder.
 Other formats may vary slightly depending on your software.

 NGons = 0 = 0%
 Overlapping Faces = 0
 Overlapping Vertices = 0
The Cinema4D version (For Each):Polygons = 94,489
 Vertices = 106,008
 Made up of only quads.
Final images rendered with V-Ray Adv 2.10.01.
 No Photoshop or compositing used, Product is ready to render out-of-the-box.
 V-Ray Light and camera are included in the file.
Model built to real-world scale (mm).
 Model is placed to 0,0,0 scene coordinates.
 Objects are in a layer and grouped for easy selection
 Every part of the model is named properly and is in a group for easy selection.
 Texture and material names correspond to model name.
 The model is efficiently UV unwrapped.
 Non-overlapping UV's are applied where it is necessary.
Texture resolution:

Texture format: JPEG (.jpg)
3ds Max 2010 and all higher versions.

description_text:
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.
Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing. We take care to build the smallest detail in the model to ensure the best results. These things are not in others.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

+ 3DS 2012Features:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth/Turbosmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

  - Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+ 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

  - No texture paths referenced by the model. All texture paths were stripped from the model.

bee3dd team

description_text:
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.
Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing. We take care to build the smallest detail in the model to ensure the best results. These things are not in others.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

+ 3DS 2012Features:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth/Turbosmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

  - Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+ 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

  - No texture paths referenced by the model. All texture paths were stripped from the model.

The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.
Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing. We take care to build the smallest detail in the model to ensure the best results. These things are not in others.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

+ 3DS 2012Features:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth/Turbosmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

  - Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+ 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

  - No texture paths referenced by the model. All texture paths were stripped from the model.

About this:
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray. Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

+ 3DS 2012Features:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth/Turbosmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

  - Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+ 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

- No texture paths referenced by the model. All texture paths were stripped from the model.About bee3dd team:

  - Top skill with hard-surface modeling

  - Can use over 10 softwaves to make 3d models

  - Offer: 3d models of electronic - car - product design - architect ( you can find a lot of model in our store )Every model we build goes through thorough Quality assessment both visual and technical to make sure the assets look realistic and the models are of the best quality.

description_text:
•         Let me present to you high-quality middle-poly 3D model Apple MacBook Air 13 2010. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real laptop that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•        The well topology of middle-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
•        The model uses 7 simple colored materials and 4 materials with 3 textures used in various combination and one of them is used as mask for sign, logos etc.
•        The total of the main textures is 3. Resolutions of all textures are from 1024 to 2048 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.• The Closing\Opening of display is animated with the simple rotation of the display group. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
•        The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
•        The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
•        Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
•        To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Middle-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Fujifilm FinePix XP70. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Model is presented in two colors: Blue and Yellow. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real camera that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of two meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only two materials (Body and Glass of Lens).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• In addition there are textures with other diffuse and specular colors. The total of additional textures is 2.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
• Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
The Yamaha CS-40M Synthesizer was a duo phone analog synthesizer introduced in 1979.  The CS-40M offered a lower cost approach to the synthesizer and was better than a monophonic synthesizer. It had 44 keys (3.5 octaves) 36 knobs, 12 sliders and over a dozen buttons.  It was designed to be used in easy performance and editing.  
This model is built to scale and includes a lot of detail in the front control panel as well as the rear plug in and power panels.  The model includes the ability to animate the individual band levels, volume, keyboard and other controls.  The model is realistic in appearance and ready for your scene.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model MSI CX61 2PC. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real laptop that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of two meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The Closing\Opening of display is animated with the simple rotation of the display mesh. All movable parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

Realistic and Detailed Apple iPhone Xs and Xs Max All Color 3d model with TurboSmooth modifier.
The main format is 3ds Max 2010, also available in many formats.
File formats included:
=================

  - 3ds Max 2010 V-Ray and Standard

  - Cinema 4D R11

  - 3ds

  - obj and

  - fbx

-V-Ray and Standard material files are included into individual archive.
-All textures included separately for all formats into each zipped folder.
Geometry and Poly Count : 3ds Max version
==================================

  - Edge-looped quads/tris based

  - No NGons faces

  - Subdivision ready poly geometry.

Render and Scene Management:
========================
-Final images rendered with V-Ray 2.0.
-No Photoshop or compositing used.
-Model built to real-world scale (mm).
-Model is placed to 0,0,0 scene coordinates.
-Objects are in a layer and grouped for easy selection
-Texture and material names correspond to model name.
-All textures are path striped.
-The model is efficiently UV unwrapped.
-Non-overlapping UV's are applied where it is necessary.
Texture resolution & Format:
======================
-Maximum: 2,048 X 2,048
-Minimum: 542 X 1,144
-JEPG (.jpg)
* Studio set-up (Light, Camera, Background) is not included.

description_text:
Hello, I am Frezzy.

The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.
Fidelity is optimal up to a 4K render. Renders have no postprocessing.
--INFO ABOUT 3D MODELS:
Features:
- High quality polygonal model, correctly scaled for an accurate representation of the original object.
- Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)
- All colors can be easily modified.
- Model is fully textured with all materials applied.
- All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.
- 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.
- No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.
- No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.
- No special plugin needed to open scene.
- Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

File Formats:
- 3ds Max 2012 V-Ray ( 2.4 ) and standard materials scenes
- OBJ (Multi Format)
- 3DS (Multi Format)
- Maya 2012
- Cinema 4D R12
- FBX (Multi Format)
All Files was archived with winrar 5.4. If you get error when extract, please use the latest version fo winrar. ( winrar is free for all )

Textures:
- High resolution ( ready for 4K rendering ) and named, easy to find and editing.
- Photoshop File ( Photoshop CC2017 was included for editing textures like you want )

Also check out my other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Dell UltraSharp U2414H. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real monitor that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• You can animate display position with the simple rotation or translation needed level display group. They are three level group hierarchy for each hinge. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Canon EF 300mm f/2.8L IS II USM Lens. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real lens that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of three meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has three materials (Lens body and Glass Lenses).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness and Bump. If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 4. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
Hugh Piggot axial flux wind turbine.  The coil former assembly is also included so as to wind your own coils.  This design is adapted from a much larger style of wind turbine that Hugh Piggot perfected.  I shrunk the design to fit on my reprap.  I have already built one and am in the process of winding the coils and setting up the electronic end of things.  check out my progress on instagram, my user name farmermacdaddy.  
The blade is a 24" wooden propeller form hobby king.  It is quite cheap.  Also I am using 36 guage copper magnet wire, and magnets that are 1 inch Dia. and 1/4 inches thick. The axel is a 3/8" bolt with a couple of cross dowel type holes for attaching the rotor plates and to use the nose cone for a nut against the cross dowel near the end of the bolt.  
Be patient with this design as it is quite new and fresh. I will be making a blog detailing all the steps to make this a functional wind turbine.  
thanks,
Shane Mawhinney

This custom designed shroud is a perfect way of cooling a passive-heatsink NVIDIA GRID M40/M60 GPGPU in a desktop case.   - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

  - Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+ 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.TEXTURES:

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Apple Watch 42mm Silver Aluminum Case with White Sport Band. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc.. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real watch that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of two meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material. 
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 3000 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model is presented in two basic poses with buckled up and unbuckled band.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• In addition we have rendered this model in other scene with HDRI lighting for more visual realism demonstration and a better understanding of materials characteristics. HDRI scene is not included for sale.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Sony PlayStation 4 Slim Game Console. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real game console that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of one mesh, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• In addition we have rendered this model in other scene with HDRI lighting for more visual realism demonstration and a better understanding of materials characteristics. HDRI scene is not included for sale.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max (2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.
See also our models:

  -   Sony Dualshock 4 Wireless Controller (2016);

  -   Sony PlayStation 4 Pro Game Console;

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Sony PlayStation 4. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real game console that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of two meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has two materials (for Console and Controller).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 10. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max (2010 version).
• Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.
See also our models:

  - Sony PlayStation 4 with Stand (with controller);

  - Sony PlayStation 4 Controller New Colors (many color versions);

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Microsoft Xbox One Wireless Controller. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc.. Model is presented in two colors: Black and White. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real controller that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of two meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has two materials (body and button glass).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• In addition there is texture with other diffuse color. 
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• In addition we have rendered this model in other scene with HDRI lighting for more visual realism demonstration and a better understanding of materials characteristics. HDRI scene is not included for sale.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text: 3D model of the AT heliostat (see wikipedia on 'Heliostat') Unlike with a conventional heliostat, the AT heliostat does not use a sensor to track the sun. Instead it relies on a printed circuit board with a precise clock that controls the two motors (to set the horizontal and vertical stance). The vertical/horizontal stance is continuously updated as time passes, and so as the sun travels from east to west. The exact horizontal/vertical settings are different at each latitude and day of the year, and thus a set of directions needs to be downloaded for the latitude/day of the year on which the heliostat is used. The settings can be determined as the path of the sun is predictable at each latitude using formula’s. See the 'Purchasing_the_models' link at appropedia's AT_CAD_Team for additional information on the model

• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Olympus Stylus Tough TG-830 Silver. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real camera that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of two meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only two materials (Body and Glass of Lens).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 3000 pixels square aspect ratio in .jpg format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
• Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Samsung NX300 Brown. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real camera that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 3000 pixels square aspect ratio in .jpg format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The Closing\Opening of display is animated with the simple rotation of display mesh and Display Group. All movable parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
• Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.
See also our model:
  - Samsung NX300 Brown mirrorless digital camera Kit 18-55mm lens;

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Asus RT-AC66U Dual-Band Wireless-AC1750 Gigabit router. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real router that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of one mesh, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 3500 pixels square aspect ratio in .jpg format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real action camera that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of one mesh, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material (also there are meshes for lens and glass and materials for them).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• In addition we have rendered this model in other scene with HDRI lighting for more visual realism demonstration and a better understanding of materials characteristics. HDRI scene is not included for sale.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Dell S2340L. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real monitor that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a three meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• You can animate display position with the simple rotation of display mesh. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.

description_text:
This is a model of a Duesenberg Double Cat guitar. Here is the official description from the Duesenberg website:
With the Double Cat Series, sleek double cutaway design meets unusual – but typical for Duesenberg – Art Deco style. Several other Duesenberg innovations further set this guitar apart from all the rest: Z Tuners, special pickups and electronics, Deluxe Tremola, and more. An F-hole with classic cat-eye styling enhances the Double Cat’s semi-hollow alder body, which sports a maple top. This Duesenberg’s Domino P90 pickup and Grand Vintage humbucker also bring to the scene perfect, full-bodied sound, which – compared to the Starplayer TV – is both a bit more wiry and somewhat more raw.

The model has been made in Cinema 4D R14 and includes some objects that will not work in earlier version, such as the Wood Shader. If everything is made editable the poly/vertex count becomes:
Vertices: 140507
Polys: 129394

The guitar has been modeled with an extreme care for details and is good for up-close renders. The model has been made in real world scale, so you can just place it in your scene and render away.
Note:
The files do not include the render setup, the Marshall speaker, or the black version of the guitar.

Enterococcus is a genus of lactic acid bacteria of the phylum Firmicutes. Enterococci are Gram-positive cocci that often occur in pairs (diplococci) or short chains and are difficult to distinguish from Streptococci on physical characteristics alone. Two species are common commensal organisms in the intestines of humans: E. faecalis (90-95%) and E. faecium (5-10%). There are rare clusters of infections with other species including E. casseliflavus, E. raffinosus.
Enterococci are facultative anaerobic organisms, i.e., they do not require oxygen for metabolism, but can survive in oxygen-rich environments. Though they are not capable of forming spores, enterococci are tolerant of a wide range of environmental conditions: extreme temperature (10-45°C), pH (4.5-10.0) and high sodium chloride concentrations.
Enterococci typically exhibit gamma-hemolysis on sheep's blood agar.

description_text:
Technics SL-1200GR Turntable.
All preview images shown are rendered with Octane Render. Plus a few screenshots of the model in the viewports of Cinema 4D, Substance Painter, and Element 3D. Enviroments and lighting setups are not included, but let me know if you want them. Modeled after the Technics SL-1200GR Turntable, but not an exact replica. The Technics logo is present in all of the textures, but easily removable. The vinyl has no texture on the bottom side.

  - Real world scale.

  - Most of the geomety is subdivision ready, with the exception of a few small parts, but i have set their weights so they wont lose shape if you subdivide the whole thing (if you use the C4D/FBX files).

  - The Glass Cover is rigged (in Cinema 4D and Element 3D) to open and close from 0% to 100% (189 degrees of rotation).

  - The Tonearm is rigged (in Cinema 4D) to animate from seated position to the begining of the vinyl (0% to 50%) and from the begining of the vinyl to the end of the vinyl (50% to 100%).

  - The Platter is rigged (in Cinema 4D) and calibrated at 30 fps (project settings) to accurately represent the following: 33.333 RPM, 44.445 RPM, and 77.778 RPM. You can also set any RPM from 0 to 100, and the Platter/Vinyl will automatically calculate the rotation based off of your project fps.

  - Fully unwrapped, non-overlapping UV's.

  - 8K PBR Textures.

  - No N-gons or Isolated Vertices.

Files include:
_C4D_Octane - Cinema 4D project file with Octane shaders, using dedicated 8K texture maps. This is where all the renders come from. Rigged as specified above. Screnshot attached.
_ORBX - Octane Standalone Package with embeded textures. Can be unpacked as OCS, or imported into any host program running Octane (or Standalone), using the orbx importer. 
_SPP - Substance Painter project file. You can edit the textures for all file formats bellow. Screnshot attached.
_TEX - Textures exported from Substance Painter and used for all the files bellow. Textures are 4K 16bit png files (Spec/Gloss PBR). Unpack in the root folder. All files point to these textures by default. Screenshot attached.
_TEX_8K - Textures exported from Substance Painter and used for all the files bellow. Textures are 8K 16bit png files (Spec/Gloss PBR). You dont need to download the 8K textures if you dont need that much detail.
_C4D - Cinema 4D scene file with Physical/Standard shaders using the PBR textures exported from Substance Painter. Rigged as specified above. Screnshot attached.
_FBX - Autodesk FBX exported from C4D. You may need to re-tweak the shaders abit, depending on the program you open it in, but all PBR textures should maintain link.
_E3D - Ready to use in Video Copilot's Element 3D, plus an After Effects project file with the model already loaded. I have exposed the Glass Cover rotation in Aux Channel 1, with proper pivot points, for easy animation. You may need to re-link the model/textures upon opening it for the first time, so just point to the root folder, where you extracted the pbr texture pack. Screnshot attached.
_OBJ - OBJ/MTL exported from Cinema 4D.
_MAX - 3ds Max project file with default shaders, using the PBR textures. May need adjustments.
Extra formats with embeded textures at various resolutions (Metal/Rough PBR): .dae (Collada), .usdz (Pixar/Apple AR), .gltf/.glb (Khronos Group).
LEGACY - All the files from previous revisions, you dont need to download this, but im keeping it in just incase.
All files are zipped.
The 3D Model can be seen in action here:

  - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OTmvQba8Le8

  - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SQaoYFsOoDM

If you have any questions or requests, dont hesitate to get in touch. Also please consider leaving a like or a comment discussing the model. Im eager to know what people think about my models, so i can find ways to improve.
Revision history:

  - December 23rd, 2018: Added PBR textures.

  - July 7th, 2019: Added 8K PBR textures. Rigged the Cover, Tonearm, and Platter. Updated the Glass Cover and Platter topologies.

description_text:
This is the high detailed 3D model of the new Samsung Galaxy S7 Android smartphone, Gold version, complete with the motherboard, SMD's, chips, battery and sim card / micro SD slot tray.
The PCB is textured and populated with parts on the front facing side.
The renders were done in Blender's Cycles render, and that is the file that includes the materials. Textures are included for all formats.
The model is available in the following extensions:.blend (main).3ds..max.dae.dxf.ma.mb.obj.fbx
Nothing is grouped or locked into place in order to enable you full customization and flexibility for all formats.
The mentioned polygon count (46,594 | blender ) is for the baseline, low poly model, and as is, it can be used for quick draft previews. I strongly suggest using 1 or 2 subdivisions (depending on how close to the model your renders will be), it's great for insane close-ups so don't shy away if the situation requires.
It's available in all official color versions, visit my library for the other variations.Samsung Galaxy S7 edge will be posted shortly, it's currently rendering, stay tuned :)
Thank you for your time and I'm looking forward to your feedback, I will get back to you in the shortest time possible.
Much love,Andee.

description_text:
This is a high detailed model of the vintage film camera Bolex H16. This model shows the build from 1966.The Bolex H16 is a vintage piece of film history, and it will be the number one eyecatcher in your architectural visualisation render. With its accurate details, it is also ideal for close up renders.The model can not be opened. It has no internal objects.
High resolution textures for PBR workflow
The model includes all textures for the body and metallic parts, as well as all textures scales and lenses.Textures for the Main Body are 8k, Diffuse, Roughness and Normal for metallic PBR Workflow.For the metal parts, the textures are 4k.The size of the scales and lenses textures varies from 2k to 4k, depending on the size of the object.
Clean model structure
The model is native modeled in Blender 2.79, and comes with logical named objects, organised in groups, all parented to logical structured empties. All Objects are modeled to real life scale, z up.Meshes are more than 99% Quads, all neccessary UV's included.
Studio Lighting Setup included
The Blend File comes with a preinstalled lighting setup. Just hit render and you will get instant good results.
The shaders are setup for use with Blender Cycles 2.79 or later.

top_reviews:
[{"score": -1, "comment": "A nicely high detailed model with some nice topology, but after starting to look at reference, the model is really off. It's also very not-animator friendly.

The arms go down too far which causes the rotor blades to cut into the top piece of plastic. I basically had to shift the arms to move the rotors up and slightly extend them upwards to make sure there was no interference, as well as scaling down the top layer by 30-40%. Now I have no more interference, but my model proportions are still bad and off.

As for what I mean with not animator-friendly. The pivots are often in places that are not re-centre-able because the topology removes vertices you could've snapped to, as well as that the rotors are at a slight off angle. If you want to animate your model, be prepared to spend 30 minutes to re-align everything just so your drone can fly.", "date": "2020-01-10"}]

Detailed 3D model of Theremin musical instrument.
Three versions included in MAX format :Vray, Mental Ray and other one with standard setings.
Texture with 4096x4096 dimmensions is provided also in PSD format ready to be customized.
PDF file with instructions is included.

description_text:
Amazon Echo Dot (2nd Generation) 
Photorealistic model of Amazon Echo Dot Second gen smart speaker with both white and black colors.
The model is realistic enough for extreme close up renders.
Blender and 3ds Max are setup render-ready with with physically based materials and background. Basecolor, Roughness and Emissive maps are included in 4096x4096 resolution (.png). Basecolor is in both black and white colors. Photoshop source file with clear organization of layers is included.
The model is mostly quads. 7746 quads (350 tris). No n-gons, co-planar faces or isolated vertices.
Blender and 3ds Max files have subdivision modifiers left untouched in stack, and can be further adjusted. Both subdivided and non-subdivided versions are in OBJ, FBX and DAE formats. Subdivided versions of those have approx 200k polys. 
The model comes with 360 equirectangular HDRI background for realistic reflections.
The wood table background in second signature image is not included.
Please see the supporting items for Photoshop texture source file and the HDRI environment image.
