description_text:
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.
Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing. We take care to build the smallest detail in the model to ensure the best results. These things are not in others.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

+ 3DS 2012Features:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth/Turbosmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

  - Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+ 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

- No texture paths referenced by the model. All texture paths were stripped from the model.Thanks you for attention. Hope you can find proffesional model for your works.

A microphone colloquially called a mic is a device – a transducer – that converts sound into an electrical signal. Microphones are used in many applications such as telephones, hearing aids, public address systems for concert halls and public events, motion picture production, live and recorded audio engineering, sound recording, two-way radios, megaphones, radio, and television broadcasting. They are also used in computers for recording voice, speech recognition, VoIP, and for non-acoustic purposes such as ultrasonic sensors or knock sensors.

description_text:
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.
Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing. We take care to build the smallest detail in the model to ensure the best results. These things are not in others.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

+ 3DS 2012Features:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth/Turbosmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

  - Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+ 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

  - No texture paths referenced by the model. All texture paths were stripped from the model.

description_text:
About this:
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray. Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

+ 3DS 2012Features:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth/Turbosmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

  - Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+ 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

- No texture paths referenced by the model. All texture paths were stripped from the model.About bee3dd team:

  - Top skill with hard-surface modeling

  - Can use over 10 softwaves to make 3d models

  - Offer: 3d models of electronic - car - product design - architect ( you can find a lot of model in our store )Every model we build goes through thorough Quality assessment both visual and technical to make sure the assets look realistic and the models are of the best quality.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Canon PowerShot Elph 130 Is Silver. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real camera that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of two meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has two materials (Body and Glass Lens).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 3500 pixels square aspect ratio in .jpg format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Olympus SP-720UZ Black. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real camera that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of three meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only two materials (Body and Glass of Lens).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 2048 pixels square aspect ratio in .jpg format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The Closing\Opening of flash is animated with the simple rotation of flash mesh. All movable parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 3000 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

Textures:

description_text:
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray. Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

+ 3DS 2012Features:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

  - Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+ 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels for models that have textures)

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

  - No texture paths referenced by the model. All texture paths were stripped from the model

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Apple iPad Pro 9.7. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc.. Model is presented in three colors: Silver, Gold, Rose Gold and Space Grey. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real tablet that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of one mesh, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• In addition there are textures with other diffuse and specular colors. The total of additional textures is 6.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• In addition we have rendered this model in other scene with HDRI lighting for more visual realism demonstration and a better understanding of materials characteristics. HDRI scene is not included for sale.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Apple iPhone 5S with Case\power bank DF iBattery-01. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Model is presented in three colors: Silver, Space Grey and Gold. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real phone and case that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of two mesh, it is low-polygonal and it has two materials (phone and case).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 10. Resolution of all textures are from 3000 to 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• In addition there are textures with other diffuse and specular colors. The total of additional textures is 3.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Onyx Boox T76SML Nefertiti. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real e-reader that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically. 
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness and Bump. If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 4. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The bending of Cover is making with fragments. These fragments of mesh have group hierarchy system. To Closing\Opening cover just animate rotation needed level group and end mesh of cover. All movable parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Samsung Galaxy Note Edge. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Model is presented in two colors: Black and White. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real phone that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of one mesh, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material for each color version.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• In addition there is texture with another diffuse color.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

A chronograph is a specific type of watch that is used as a stopwatch combined with a display watch. A basic chronograph has an independent sweep second hand and a minute sub-dial; it can be started, stopped, and returned to zero by successive pressure on the stem. More complex chronographs use additional complications and can have multiple sub-dials to measure seconds, minutes, hours and even tenths of a second. In addition, many modern chronographs use moveable bezels as tachymeters for rapid calculations of speed or distance. Louis Moinet invented the chronograph in 1816 for use in tracking astronomical objects.[1][2] Chronographs were also used heavily in artillery fire in the mid to late 1800s. More modern uses of chronographs involve aircraft piloting, auto racing, diving and submarine maneuvering.

description_text:
This pack contains a high quality, low-poly military transceiver that can be used in any realtime renderer that supports the physically based rendering pipeline (metallic workflow). If you're unsure what this means, the model is probably not compatible with your render engine. (The package doesn't contain traditional specular/gloss maps and the .fbx file doesn't contain embedded media!)
The model is highly detailed, one emission map is provided and animations are baked in for the cooling fans. Those meshes are also separated so you can animate them yourself at ease. (The model contains a properly unwrapped lightmap channel in UV1.)
Available formats: .OBJ, .FBX, .DAEMaterial count: 1
Texture maps: Base color, metallic, roughness, normal, ambient occlusion, emission map, opacity map (alpha mask)Format: Lossless .PNG (8bits/channel)Resolution: 4K (crisp clear from close-up, decrease as needed)
The asset was created with 3DS Max, high-poly sculpted with ZBrush, textured with Substance Painter.
Should you have any questions in regards with any of my products, don't hesitate to contact me here!

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model AEE Magicam SD18B action camera. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real camera that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of three meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has three materials (Body, Glass and Lens).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 2048 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

Polycom entered the video conferencing market in 1998. Polycom introduced the ViewStation product line which included models with embedded multipoint capabilities, content sharing capabilities, and support for the emerging H.323 IP network protocol. In 2000, Polycom introduced a personal desktop video conferencing appliance called ViaVideo. The compact device was essentially a webcam with onboard processing capabilities, to offset the compute limitations of most desktop and laptop computers at the time. As computer processing power increased, Polycom transitioned the desktop solution to a software-based client called Polycom PVX.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Apple iPhone 5S with Case Puro Ultra Slim. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Model is presented in three colors: Silver, Space Grey and Gold. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real phone and case that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has two materials (phone and case).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 10. Resolution of all textures are from 3000 to 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• In addition there are textures with other diffuse and specular colors. The total of additional textures is 3.
• The Closing\Opening of case model is animated with the simple rotation of the cover mesh and cover group.. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Bower 500mm f/8.0 Manual Focus Telephoto T-Mount Lens. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real lens that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of two meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has two materials (Lens body and Glass Lenses).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness and Bump. If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 4. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• In addition we have rendered this model in other scene with HDRI lighting for more visual realism demonstration and a better understanding of materials characteristics. HDRI scene is not included for sale.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model 24mm f/3.5 ED AS UMC Tilt-Shift Lens for Nikon. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real lens that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of a few meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has two materials (for Lens body and Glass of Lens).
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness and Bump. If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 4. Resolution of all textures is 2048 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Lenovo Yoga Tablet 10 HD Golden. • The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Lenovo Yoga Tablet 8. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real tablet that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically. 
•    Ease of use consists of two meshes, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The moving of leg is animated with the simple rotation of leg mesh. All rotating parts are animated for a demo in the scene.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.
